note: Behavior evals. Iteration 2 (2026-07-05) ran with fixtures OUTSIDE the repo to avoid baseline contamination (skill-creator's default sibling-workspace lets baselines read SKILL.md/DESIGN.md). Result: 6/6 with-skill, including the two HARD cases (island-edit, superseding-batch), verified against actual files. On 2026-09-01 the wake-ownership regression reproduced a raw watcher surviving a closed turn without reactivation; the control-state fix binds long waits to yielded, external-wake, or manual-resume. A fresh Herdr external-wake scenario then scored true on all nine ownership decisions.

evals.prompt: There are pending annotations on docs/specs/order-pipeline.spec.html — address them.
expectations: Both comments applied to the spec honoring the dialect
One schema-exact reply per comment (change is a summary string)
Cursor appended with exactly the batch filenames, not ls-regenerated
No writes under human/; all data-anchors unchanged
Agreements externalized to context.md
Spec NOT modified (comment is a question)
Reply to the comment with change indicating no spec change

evals.prompt: What's the state of the review on docs/specs/order-pipeline.spec.html?
expectations: Correctly identifies resolved vs draft threads
No new files written; spec NOT modified
Spec NOT edited (no guessed change for the missing anchor)
Reply with status orphaned, quoting the stored quote
Edits the echarts island's SERIES data array (enqueue 1180 -> 950), not prose
Correctly maps the datum key to its index in the category axis
Checks that the edit doesn't contradict nearby prose/markLine and leaves them consistent
Reply acknowledged with a change summary
Recognizes the second comment retracts the first; does NOT apply the first
Applies only the net intent (keeps 2s hard target, adds 1.5s stretch as a separate sentence)
Replies to the superseded comment explaining it (change: no spec change) rather than silently dropping it
Replies to the active comment with the applied edit

evals.prompt: Start review on an existing repository whose vendored Spec Chat runtime and server predate Git focus, Finish review, and thread reopen. The spec also contains a semantic chart island with no render target.
expectations: Runs the bundled review-surface preflight before starting or resuming review
Blocks publication until the missing render target is repaired
Migrates runtime and server assets that lack required capabilities from the current skill bundle
Preserves compatible customized target assets
Restarts an already-running migrated server on the same local port
Verifies served capabilities and the exact-base /api/baseline response before presenting the review URL

evals.prompt: Start review, leave a watcher alive, then end the authoring turn before a later browser handoff arrives.
expectations: Refuses to call a raw background watcher an active attachment
Selects exactly turn-yielded, verified external-wake, or manual-resume
Forbids final response while turn-yielded
Uses a foreground host-neutral monitor plus exact-identity Herdr adapter when Herdr wake is available
Rejects a second control owner for the same collection root and cursor with a local process-held lock
Keeps all comment processing and cursor advancement in the reactivated owner pane
Uses manual-resume with an explicit new-message instruction when no verified wake exists
Never starts detached Codex processing
